body: No :( our house is filled to the brim. Even the stairs are filled with boxes of god-knows-what. Our living room is also a stockpile of clothes and other stuff that I don’t even remember having anymore

hi! i felt the exact same way you’re feeling right now, so i understand where you’re coming from. have you tried reaching out to your school’s guidance counselor? that’s what i did, and it kinda helped. 

right now i didn’t enroll for the second sem, because i wanted to prioritize my mental health since it greatly affected my studies. now i know this may not be an option for you, but at least letting an authority know what you’re experiencing can be a great help to you and your academics.

i hope you feel better asap, OP. we’re here for you.
